faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RMLIMS Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the RMLIMS Medical Officer post is 01-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a valid registration from the respective state Medical Council or the National Medical Commission (NMC) to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Medical Officer post is between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 62 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 72,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RMLIMS Medical Officer job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. Candidates must download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Officer post in the Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this RMLIMS Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a contractual basis. Candidates should be aware of the terms and conditions associated with contractual employment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be downloaded from the official website of Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences. Direct links are provided in the 'Important Links' section.
